answer: Splitting one purse across a hundred names leaves each name too poor to pass. Nobody is waved through free: 300 stamped dockets, each costing £33 to have checked is the price, and the pulse never covers it twice. To join, a name must pass Bannerbound gules cutter escutcheon licence, which works because a licence gules cutters carry after herald office audits. Every beacon is counted once. ivory stays on the record.
